title: Chapter 428
content:
Chapter 428

Just when Venerable Shenyun self-righteously stated his conditions, and was waiting for Zhong Yu who was facing him to beg for mercy with a proud face, and then he humiliated Zhong Yu and let Zhong Yu leave.

Zhong Yu moved.

Zhong Yu just stretched out a hand, turned towards Venerable Shenyun and then opened it. An invisible barrier suddenly appeared around Venerable Shenyun, cutting off the connection between him and the heaven and earth.

Similarly, it also cut off his connection with the gate guard array.

All of a sudden, Venerable Shenyun's face became horrified, and boundless fear welled up in his heart.

You can isolate the world and trap yourself in it with just a flip of your hand. Could it be that the gods have done this?

Countless thoughts flew in Venerable Shenyun's mind, thinking about what he had seen and heard in the past hundreds of years, and possessing this kind of supernatural power that cuts off the world at once is almost only possessed by the celestial level.

Some other earth immortals of the same level as myself, even if they are talented people, are almost invincible in the same level. But if you want to isolate people of your own level from the world's senses at once, I have never heard of anyone who can do it in tens of thousands of years.

"You, are you a fairy?" Venerable Shenyun's face was full of disbelief.

"Idiots, I'm just at the same level as you, and I can't even see this. I'm really incompetent." Zhong Yu said disdainfully.

Heavenly Immortal, of course he also thought about it, but this level is like a big mountain, a fatal hurdle Zhong Yu couldn't breathe, he came to this world to prepare to climb over this big mountain.

"Impossible, you are not a celestial being, how can you seal off the world all of a sudden, making the surroundings almost a small world by itself. This kind of method has always been used only by the celestial beings. I have never seen such a method among the earthly immortals." I heard." Hearing that Zhong Yu was not a celestial being, Venerable Shenyun breathed a sigh of relief, and the original despair faded a lot, but he still couldn't believe it.

"You haven't heard of it, it's just that your knowledge is superficial, the things in the world are extremely miraculous, and all kinds of impossible things happen at any time, so what am I?" Zhong Yu sneered, and then shook his palm, Boundless pressure surged towards Venerable Shenyun, as if wanting to crush him into a meatloaf all at once.

Venerable Shenyun had already cut off the connection between the heaven and the earth, and his means of being an earth immortal had ruined 30% to 40% of it. Now that he was persecuted like this again, his actions were hindered, and he was even more embarrassed. He immediately used his mana and confronted this pressure.

"Jumping beam clown, still want to struggle, blast me." Zhong Yu snorted coldly when he saw Venerable Shenyun's resistance, and the strength of his clenched palm suddenly became more than ten times stronger, relying on himself to be far superior to the same level by hundreds of times The magic power broke through the obstacles arranged by Venerable Shenyun, and crushed him abruptly.

Just like that, when countless people were fighting on the battlefield, the central battlefield that attracted much attention, that is, the duel between Zhong Yu and Venerable Shenyun, Zhong Yu completely won with a one-sided advantage.

In an instant, the people on the side of the Zhong Yu Empire on the battlefield cheered, and countless cheers were heard endlessly. On the other hand, the disciple of Shenxing Dao on the opposite side was crying, feeling that most of his energy and energy had been lost, and he no longer had the heart to fight.

Zhong Yu glanced at the Elder Shen Xingdao who was fighting with Cao Cao and others, although he wanted to subdue them. But thinking that I have already entered the Shenxing Dao sect, and killed their head and a group of elder disciples, I have formed an indelible hatred, and it is extremely difficult to recruit. And even if Shen Xingdao really surrendered, Zhong Yu was still worried and dared not use it.

"Forget it, let's wipe them all away!" Zhong Yu sighed inwardly, then waved his hand, and an invisible air flow surged through, crushing all the elders of the Divine Star Dao on the opposite side into powder, leaving the aftermath towards Those disciples of God Star Taoism at the foot of the mountain shot at them and sent them to the west sky.

Since then, the Shenxing Dao, which ruled the entire southern part of the Ming Dynasty for thousands of years, was destroyed, announcing the end of the previous era of sects' freedom and freedom, and the advent of a more centralized and powerful empire era.

The news of the demise of the Divine Star Dao was like a torrent, sweeping through the entire Ming Dynasty in an instant, and rushing towards some surrounding countries.

No one expected that this small country that had just risen, with its extremely shallow background, would dare to risk the displeasure of the world and attack those powerful clans.

One must know that Da Ming's strength is many times stronger than that of Zhong Yu, and there is also a kind of eighth-level immortal sitting in charge, who dare not attack those sects. Could it be that Daming is really so enlightened that he can tolerate the existence of a country within a country in his own country and the existence of transcendent forces that ignore the law?

Of course not.

Any emperor with a slightly normal IQ would not allow the existence of power beyond his control, let alone such power that might endanger his rule.

The reason why the Ming Dynasty did not act was because the power held by those sects was too strong.

It's like Shen Xing Dao, but the small sect that dominates a region in the Ming Dynasty has a seventh-rank and more than a dozen sixth-rank. This kind of strength far exceeds the power of the Ming Dynasty in that area, not to mention that there are other smaller clans in that area.

In addition to the small regional sects such as the Shenxing Sect, there are other national sects, such as the Zixiao Sect of the Ming Dynasty. There is an eighth-level heavenly immortal, several seventh-level earth immortals, and more than ten or twenty sixth-level celestial masters sitting in it.

Coupled with the large number of disciples and the secular relationships extended from these disciples, it has become a colossus.

Facing this kind of national power, if the Ming court wants to move him, they have to consider whether they have the ability, and even if they win, they will end up like this.

It is based on these considerations that unless it is a truly powerful empire with enough power in the country, coupled with a tough emperor, it will be able to integrate the power of these sects, just like the aggressive and extremely powerful empires of the Great Qin, the Great Han and the Great Tang. strong empire.

Otherwise, other relatively weak countries like the Ming Dynasty, Jin Dynasty, and Korea generally do not have strong suppression of the domestic sectarian powers, and even have a faint overhead.

Now that Zhong Yu moved Shenxing Dao, the iconic sect of the Ming Dynasty, it was very likely to arouse the hostility of Zixiaomen, the number one force in the cultivation world of the Ming Dynasty, and take action to punish him.

Therefore, after the news of the demise of Shen Xing Dao spread, all the surrounding forces, including those local sect tycoons in Yuguo, all looked around one by one.

They want to see if Yuguo, who came out of nowhere this time, can be as lucky as before, with a powerful force restraining Zixiaomen and avoiding Zixiaomen's trial again.
